name: Oc mo
summary: Ốc mỡ is cooked as ốc mỡ xào me and as ốc mỡ rang me. The snail is sweet and soft.
origin: Can Gio. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, at Hàng Dương.
howToEat: Stir-fried with tamarind in the 2014 story, or tossed with tamarind in the 2019 caption.
where: Hàng Dương for the 2019 caption. The 2014 story names no street. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Oc mo — tamarind snail in Can Gio
seoDescription: Ốc mỡ is cooked with tamarind, sweet and soft, as xào me or rang me.
texture: Sweet and soft, in the 2014 story.
